channel.title: KeePassXC not opening on new fresh baremetal instalation
channel.description: As title says, new installation on thinkpad x560, i even downloaded the appimage from their site, it wont open either. Opens fine inside vbox on my home pc so its a laptop problem as far as i know.

item.title: KeePassXC not opening on new fresh baremetal instalation
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
Banebere:

OK it gets more ridiculous. KeePass works on that laptop INSIDE both kicksecure and whonix vm’s

When i try from terminal it spits error
zsh: illegal hardware instruction (core dumped) keepassxc

Might be triggered by a hardening setting. Some of our configuration causes specific hardware to malfunction but not others.

Reboot the system, but on the boot menu, press the e key to edit boot settings, Move your cursor to the line that starts with linux, then remove gather_data_sampling=force from the command line. Then press Ctrl+X to boot. If KeePassXC works then, reboot into sysmaint mode, then use the following instructions to remove gather_data_sampling=force permanently:

Kicksecure – 13 May 26

Permanent Configuration Changes - grub bootloader Configuration Changes

Follow these steps to permanently change GRUB configuration settings such as add and/or remove kernel boot parameters. | Kernel Boot Parameter Changes

Some documentation about gather_data_sampling=force sometimes causing issues:

github.com/Kicksecure/security-misc

Comment by adrelanos - `gather_data_sampling=force` - Enable Gather Data Sampling (GDS) mitigation - related to CPU `AVX` instruction; More CPU Mitigations and Additional References

master ← raja-grewal:secure_cpu

This has broken: * `wc -l` (fixed in Debian `trixie`) * `rspamd --version` (…rspamd totally broken) (reported upstream) Error message: > illegal hardware instruction (core dumped) More information here: * https://github.com/rspamd/rspamd/issues/5137

github.com/rspamd/rspamd

[BUG] `rspamd --version` `illegal hardware instruction` in function `rspamd_cryptobox_test_instr` caused by Linux kernel parameter `gather_data_sampling=force` (Enable Gather Data Sampling (GDS) mitigation)

closed 04:51PM - 16 Dec 24 UTC

item.title: KeePassXC not opening on new fresh baremetal instalation
item.dc:creator: nite_route
item.description:
hmm if the appimage wont open either its probably not the flatpak/package itself. in my experience on thinkpads that usually ends up being a missing qt/xcb lib or the app crashing on start before any window shows.

maybe try from a terminal:
keepassxc
or the appimage path, and see what error dumps out

also journalctl --user -xe right after a failed launch sometimes shows the qt plugin / libxcb thing. if its a black box with no error, QT_DEBUG_PLUGINS=1 can be noisy but useful.

probably not kicksecure-specific if vbox works, more like the bare metal session libs.
